_about: Source-permission registry. One row per source. A collector runs automatically only when its row's ruling is 'allowed'. Only the lead changes 'ruling' (after a fact-check ruling). Fields: see tools/trends/README.md.

sources.name: Roblox Games API: game details (playing, visits, favoritedCount)
sources.purpose: Timestamped public counters for watched games: online count, cumulative visits, cumulative favorites (trend scout history)
sources.quota: Observed headers (not a guarantee): games 300 per 60 s, votes 200 per 60 s; games batch max 50 ids (documented). fact-check-roblox.md §1.2
sources.notes: Owner decision J004-D10 (2026-10-21): no collection from Roblox's own services at all, to avoid any risk to the studio's Roblox account (new Terms from 2026-11-01 §9.2 ban automated data gathering in connection with AI). Was 'allowed with conditions' under the Terms in force until 2026-10-31 (J004-T03, fact-check-roblox.md §1). Roblox game numbers come only from what the owner reads and pastes (J004-D12).

sources.name: Roblox Games API: up and down votes
sources.purpose: Timestamped public vote counters for watched games (votes added per week, approval)
sources.quota: Observed header (not a guarantee): 200 per 60 s; batch maximum not documented. fact-check-roblox.md §1.2
sources.notes: Owner decision J004-D10 (2026-10-21): no collection from Roblox's own services at all, to avoid any risk to the studio's Roblox account (new Terms from 2026-11-01 §9.2 ban automated data gathering in connection with AI). Was 'allowed with conditions' under the Terms in force until 2026-10-31 (J004-T03, fact-check-roblox.md §1). Roblox game numbers come only from what the owner reads and pastes (J004-D12).

sources.name: Roblox place to universe lookup
sources.purpose: Resolve a root place ID to its universe ID once, when a game is added to the watchlist
sources.notes: Lead ruling J004-T03: the route answers but is not in the Creator Hub Games reference, so it is not a documented means (Terms: 'Only access an API by the means described in the documentation'). Not allowed under both Terms versions. Resolve place ids to universe ids by hand from the game page.

sources.name: Apple App Store RSS feeds: top free and top paid apps
sources.purpose: Daily app rank panel per fixed country (rank movement; not downloads, not revenue)
sources.quota: none stated; one fetch per country and feed per run
sources.notes: Lead ruling J004-T04 (knowledge/reference/trends/fact-check-outside.md §3): content 'purposely made available'. Top-grossing not built (unverified, 504 on probe). Feed has no category filter: items are apps, not games.

sources.name: Steam Web API: ISteamUserStats/GetNumberOfCurrentPlayers
sources.purpose: Current players for a short watchlist of Steam app ids
sources.notes: terms name end-user display, not internal analytics; owner decision pending (J004 digest). Respect Cache-Control max-age; fail soft (Valve can end access without notice).

sources.name: YouTube Data API v3: public video statistics for a fixed panel
sources.purpose: Per-video view velocity for a fixed channel, video and query panel (per-video arithmetic only)
sources.notes: Lead ruling J004-T04 (knowledge/reference/trends/fact-check-outside.md §3): Non-Authorized Data may not be stored over 30 days (records and pages; `prune`). No channel scores, channel rankings, genre labels or blends with outside data without approval.

sources.name: Steam store charts (Top Sellers, Most Played, weekly Top Sellers)

sources.notes: Lead ruling J004-T04 (knowledge/reference/trends/fact-check-outside.md §3-§4). Record rank, app name, app id, country or global, date, free-to-play flag.

sources.name: SullyGnome: trending games on Twitch (third-party Twitch stats)
sources.route: https://sullygnome.com/games/3/trending (and 7/14/30-day views); page has a CSV/Excel export button
sources.purpose: Twitch watch-time and stream-time change per game, to spot games rising on Twitch
sources.notes: Lead check 2026-10-21 (owner request J004-D6): ToS (updated 19/06/21) allow using and sharing snippets of data/tables/charts with credit to SullyGnome.com, and say 'You may not use automated means to scrape data from the site, you may not directly call any of the APIs or attempt to copy large sections'; robots.txt disallows GPTBot. So the owner reads or exports the trending table; the scout converts the owner's file into the manual CSV; the agent never fetches the site. Credit SullyGnome.com on every page that shows its figures. Labels: 3P-S. J004-D7: an agent may read RoTrends/SullyGnome in a visible browser only when the owner asks in chat (human pace, few pages, figures only, never scheduled). J004-D12 supersedes J004-D7: owner reads only; no agent reads, even on request.

sources.name: Roblox trackers: Rolimon's, RoVitals, RoTrends, RoStats, Statroblox
sources.purpose: Weekly facts read by hand by a person (manual import)
sources.notes: Lead ruling J004-T04 (knowledge/reference/trends/fact-check-outside.md §3-§4). Viewing by hand only; no scraping, no export. Third-party figures keep their own label. J004-T03: Rolimon's licence is 'personal, non-commercial transitory viewing only': not used for studio decisions until Rolimon's gives written consent (owner digest 2026-10-21). RoTrends and RoStats forbid automated access; RoVitals and Statroblox unclear: hand reading only. RoTrends (checked 2026-10-21, J004-D4): terms of Chartis gg, INC govern rotrends.com; licence for 'personal or internal business purposes'; 'data-mining, robots, or similar data-gathering tools' barred 'except via documented APIs or with our written consent': owner reads or exports; agent does not fetch. J004-D7: an agent may read RoTrends/SullyGnome in a visible browser only when the owner asks in chat (human pace, few pages, figures only, never scheduled). J004-D12 supersedes J004-D7: owner reads only; no agent reads, even on request.
